info.title: udb 0.5.6 — proto-driven multi-database broker
info.description: Version-matched launcher for the UDB CLI (0.5.6).

commands.name: Admin
commands.description:
admin force-sync       Force the startup lifecycle from the CLI and exit with a JSON report.
admin release-lock     Terminate the PG session(s) holding the startup advisory lock (clear a stale lock).
admin reset-db         Drop all UDB-managed schemas + ledger tables (DESTRUCTIVE; needs --yes).
admin dry-run          Generate the SQL plan and exit WITHOUT applying (safe on production).
admin verify-audit     Verify the tamper-evident admin audit-log hash chain.
sync-migrations        Sync db_ops/migrations with the current proto AST.

commands.name: create
commands.description:
Mint an API key (tenant-scoped).
auth api-key list/revoke List an owner's API keys or revoke one OFFLINE (UDB-AUTH-009 rotation/reconciliation).

commands.name: user
commands.description: Mint the FIRST admin OFFLINE (no running broker needed); prints the canonical tenant UUID.

options.name: --project
options.description:
it, not the human code, goes in the login JWT and tenant-scoped filters.
After this you MUST seed ABAC (default-deny) before any data CRUD works.

commands.name: cert-binding
commands.description: Manage mTLS certificate bindings through the authenticated native API.

commands.name: grant
commands.description: Manage typed service-account grants through the authenticated native API.

options.name: --expected-revision
options.description:
rotate-identity: --tenant <tenant-id> --user <uuid> --identity <new-id>
revoke:  --tenant <tenant-id> --user <uuid> [--reason <r>]
Wildcard/admin/owner scopes are always rejected. Replace and identity rotation
bump the revision, invalidating dependent keys and bindings until re-issued.

commands.name: migrate-grants
commands.description: Migrate legacy profile-attribute service grants into the typed service_account_grants table.

commands.name: put
commands.description: Write a control-plane Casbin governance rule (NOT the data-plane ABAC gate).

commands.name: seed
commands.description: Seed the STANDARD data-plane authorization for a project (idempotent, offline).

commands.name: catalog
commands.description: Dump the parsed proto catalog as JSON.

commands.name: Core
commands.description:
serve                  Start the broker (syncs schema from protos; control plane on data-port+10).
requirements           Print the backend contract this project's manifest declares (run before first start).
doctor                 Env + backend readiness; --enterprise adds a manifest-aware prerequisite preflight.

commands.name: Diagnostics
commands.description:
compat-matrix          Print the authoritative supported proto-annotation matrix as JSON.
explain                Explain the generated DDL/DSN/policies for a message type.
health-check           Lightweight Docker HEALTHCHECK — exit 0 if healthy.
tracker-ddl            Emit the migration-ledger table DDL to stdout.
config-skeleton        Emit a default MigrationOptions config skeleton as JSON.

commands.name: drift
commands.description: Diff the manifest against a prior one; flags destructive/blocked changes.

commands.name: dsn
commands.description: Print the unified DSN catalog derived from the protos.

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Lint the catalog built from your annotated protos (CI-safe; nonzero on errors).

commands.name: manifest-export
commands.description: Export the current CatalogManifest to JSON (for CI plan-approval).

commands.name: list
commands.description: Inspect the descriptor-derived native-service contract.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Build a migration plan (optionally vs a prior manifest) as JSON.

commands.name: policy-lint
commands.description: Lint ABAC policy files from UDB_ABAC_POLICY_FILE (nonzero on broken files).

commands.name: policy-seed
commands.description: Generate INSERT SQL to seed ABAC policies into the UDB ABAC table.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Vendor UDB's annotation protos so app protos can import udb/core/common/v1/db.proto.

commands.name: Scaffold
commands.description:
init                   Project-aware scaffold planner/executor.
init-project           Scaffold a minimal project (sample proto, config, DDL, docker-compose).
app init               Scaffold an app integration wiring the UdbProject facade.
dev up                 Start/stop/test the local multi-backend sandbox (from a repo checkout).

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate/refresh a language SDK from the embedded RPC manifest + templates.

commands.name: sql
commands.description: Emit the generated bootstrap SQL artifacts as JSON (no DB touched).
